Priya (support): Hi — customer hitting 400 on /v1/rerank. They say request JSON "looks fine" but our endpoint returns "items must be array". Can someone help triage?

dev-frontend (customer): Posting the curl they used (sanitized token):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"items":"[{\"id\":\"p1\",\"candidates\":[{\"text\":\"Candidate A\"}] }], \"top_k\": 2.5 }'
```

Priya (support): I see two issues in that payload: the top-level `items` value is a string (they stringified the array) and `top_k` is a fractional number. Our schema expects `items` to be an array of objects and `top_k` to be an integer. Also candidate objects should include `id` (optional) and `score` is allowed but not required for input — however scores must be numeric if present.

Tom (eng): Validator returns ERR-RERANK-400-INVALID-TYPES for cases like this. RerankLintBot will flag common patterns. Can you share the exact response body and the Request-ID from the response?

dev-frontend (customer): Response body: {"error":"Invalid request","code":"ERR-RERANK-400-INVALID-TYPES","details":"items must be array"} Request-ID: req_0a1b2c

Priya (support): Thanks. Quick repro we ran locally (bad):
```json
{"items":"[ {\"id\":\"p1\", \"candidates\": [{\"text\":\"A\"}] } ]","top_k":2.5}
```
Fixed payload that works:
```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id": "p1", "candidates": [{"id": "c1", "text": "Candidate A"}]}
  ],
  "top_k": 2
}
```

Tom (eng): Action items: 1) Priya — ask customer to send a POST with the corrected `items` as a JSON array and integer `top_k`. 2) I'll add a clearer error hint for fractional `top_k` (currently generic type error). 3) Dev team: check if older JS SDK versions auto-stringify arrays when serializing; if yes, publish a patch note.

Priya (support): Also leaving this here in case others hit it: common client mistakes that produce 400s for rerank — stringified arrays in `items`, `top_k` non-integer, candidate list empty (`[]`) and top_k > candidates length (server currently returns validation 400), or candidate objects with `text` missing.

RerankLintBot: Note added to ticket req_0a1b2c — suggested workaround included.

dev-frontend (customer): Sent new request with corrected body, got 200. Thanks all! :tada:
